rules:
; replaces the Nov 25 book, kept as data/book-v1-2026-11-25.json):
  The paper book is a frozen copy of Record › Top-20 book, so the Brief, Companies filters, What's next highlights and the
  tracked book are one list. NAV $250M. 15 longs + 5 shorts ranked on the conviction score plus a tilt for the next catalyst.
  Weight = base (longs 5%, shorts 3% of NAV) x conviction (score / median pick, 0.6-1.6) x catalyst skew (0.8-1.3) x vol
  scaler (0.6-1.4), capped at 8% / 5% of NAV, 10 days of 20% ADV and 4.9% of the company; names that cannot reach 1% of NAV
  are skipped. Long-biased by design (no XBI hedge); P&L is shown against XBI and the average covered stock.
  Entry = latest close in the price cache. No costs, borrow or dividends.

toc.e: Q4 2026 topline: 44-wk body-composition, 30-wk T2D and SWITCH studies

positions.why: Long: aleniglipron gave 16.3% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 44 weeks with no plateau and 2-3% discontinuation for side effects, and {cash} of cash is about the whole {cap} cap.
positions.name: Structure Therapeutics Inc.

toc.e: QUELL-CV Ph2 topline (12-week hsCRP) in Q4 2026

positions.why: Long: BGE-102, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor, cut hsCRP ≥85% in Ph1, and the company trades below its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: BioAge Labs, Inc.

positions.why: Long: AD109 could be the first oral drug for obstructive sleep apnea; two Ph3s cut AHI 55.6% vs 19.1% (SynAIRgy) and 46.8% vs 6.8% (LunAIRo), with a PDUFA on Feb 28 2027.
positions.name: Apnimed, Inc.

positions.why: Long: Descartes-08 is an outpatient mRNA CAR-T in myasthenia gravis with a 6.6-point MG-ADL reduction at 12 months after retreatment and an SPA-locked Ph3.
positions.name: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc.

toc.e: FDA PDUFA decision on lonvo-z (HAE), priority review

positions.why: Long: lonvo-z met all HAELO endpoints (NEJM), with most patients attack-free and off treatment after one 50 mg dose; priority review sets a Mar 10 2027 PDUFA with no advisory committee.
positions.name: Intellia Therapeutics, Inc.

toc.e: Sura-vec wet AMD pivotal topline Q4 2026

positions.why: Long: RGX-202 met its Duchenne pivotal endpoint, with 93% of patients above 10% micro-dystrophin (p<0.0001) and functional gains; BLA due Q1 2027.
positions.name: REGENXBIO Inc.

positions.why: 60% ORR with 15.2mo mPFS in first-in-class EGFR-NCM NSCLC setting (n=43); prob-adj ~$245M vs $700M peak on POS 35% — data quality argues for accumulation into Ph3 design news.
positions.name: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: 63.1% ORR (n=65) in 1L NSCLC single-arm is exceptional but unconfirmed; TeLuRide-008 registrational Ph2/3 (n=750) now recruiting as of Jul 14 2026 with first interim for dose selection due 2H 2027.
positions.name: Eikon Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long into the Dec 22 PDUFA: lorundrostat has two positive pivotals (placebo-adjusted SBP −9.1 mmHg in Launch-HTN, −7.9 mmHg in Advance-HTN) on top of background therapy.
positions.name: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long: miv-cel is the first CAR-T with a significant registrational result in stiff-person syndrome (49% median walking-speed gain, 92% off immunotherapy at one year).
positions.name: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long into the PDUFA: D-PLEX100 cut surgical-site infections 60% (p=0.0013) in Ph3.
positions.name: PolyPid Ltd.

positions.why: 65% ORR (n=17) vs 37-43% approved agents remains best-in-class on paper but is still the same Jan 2026 dataset reiterated by JPMorgan's Jul 2026 initiation — MONITOR until H2 2026 larger cohort data confirms durability.
positions.name: BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Long: two base-editing assets with human data. BEAM-302 lifted total AAT to 12.4 µM at 60 mg in 29 AATD patients, above the 11 µM protective level, and risto-cel is on track for a sickle-cell BLA as early as YE2026.
positions.name: Beam Therapeutics Inc.

positions.why: Long: OCU400 is a gene-agnostic retinitis pigmentosa therapy with completed Ph3 enrollment, against a {cap} cap.
positions.name: Ocugen, Inc.

positions.why: Long: verekitug cut asthma exacerbations 56% vs placebo (p<0.001) with dosing every 12 weeks, and the company trades well below its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: Upstream Bio, Inc.

positions.why: Short: SEP-479, an oral PTH1R agonist, is in healthy-volunteer Ph1, yet the stock rose ~70% in a year to a {cap} cap.
positions.name: Septerna, Inc.

positions.why: Short: CR-001 is a PD-1×VEGF bispecific with no human data, chasing ivonescimab, which itself just received a CRL.
positions.name: Crescent Biopharma, Inc.

positions.why: Short: AKY-1189 has no efficacy data until 1Q27, and the company trades well above its {cash} of cash.
positions.name: Aktis Oncology, Inc.

toc.e: ANB033 (anti-CD122) Ph1b celiac histologic / biomarker topline

positions.why: Strong short: one positive gluten-challenge cohort (villus:crypt +0.49 vs placebo) supports a {cap} valuation, and a same-mechanism competitor is about a year ahead.
positions.name: First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc.

positions.why: Short: after two failed programs, Alector's value rests on a preclinical brain-carrier platform and AL137, whose IND slipped to Q1 2027.
positions.name: Alector, Inc.
